body_html:
Alex “Lightning” is an Atlanta-based DJ known for his high energy, sharp crowd awareness, and ability to turn great events into unforgettable experiences. Rather than relying on preset playlists, Alex mixes live and reads the room in real time, keeping the energy exactly where it needs to be, whether that means a packed dance floor, an elevated cocktail hour, or a high-impact school or corporate event.

Musically, Alex’s foundation is Hip-Hop and R&B, but his versatility spans all genres. His go-to floor fillers include artists like Pitbull and Usher, and he excels at blending styles to keep guests engaged across generations. His favorite events to perform are Weddings and Mitzvahs, where timing, transitions, and energy management are critical to a seamless celebration.

Clients value Alex for his professionalism, organization, and clear communication throughout the planning process, as well as his ability to move a crowd without being cheesy or overdone. From clean transitions to professional sound and lighting, he ensures every detail runs smoothly and stress-free.

Outside of DJing, Alex is currently working toward his commercial pilot’s license with the goal of becoming a Delta pilot, bringing the same discipline, preparation, and attention to detail to his events that define his approach to aviation.
